decisions.reason: As a training offer that builds directly on the firm's existing application know-how and training capabilities, it fits the firm's strong absorptive capacity and is likely to be retained.
This accessory extends the established machine platform and can be understood, improved, and sold through the firm's existing engineering and service knowledge, so management would likely keep it.

Because hybrid additive post-processing is relatively distant from the firm's established knowledge base, even with in-house R&D the firm has weaker absorptive capacity here and is more likely to discontinue it.

A high-speed CNC milling machine is very close to the firm's core business, and with strong in-house R&D and a multi-model product line the firm has every reason to continue developing and marketing it.
The automatic tool change system builds on the firm's modular engineering, machine integration, and customer support strengths, making it a good candidate to keep on the market.
